title: chore(web): remove unused button variants and model-monitor sdk dep
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Small dead-code cleanup split out of #15060. No visual change to pollinations.ai.

- Removes the unused `toggle`, `copy` and `remove` button variants and the unused `buttonVariants` export
- `LazyMarkdownGfm` reuses `LazyMarkdown` instead of duplicating its Suspense wrapper
- Drops the unused `@pollinations/sdk` dependency from model-monitor (it only uses SDK types via `@pollinations/ui`, and its deploy installs the root workspace anyway)

The earlier version also swapped the website's coloured CTA buttons, header/footer pills, social icon tiles and accent chip links for plain `InlineLink` text links. That is a redesign, not a cleanup, so it is dropped here; website v2 (#14472) covers the new link style.

Checked: website `tsc`, `vite build` and tests pass; built CSS differs from main only by rules for the removed variants. model-monitor `npm ci`, tests and build pass.

gist.headline: A little garden pruning
gist.blurb: A few unused button variants and a spare dependency left the garden. The website looks exactly the same.
gist.summary: Removed the unused toggle, copy, and remove button variants and buttonVariants export, made LazyMarkdownGfm reuse LazyMarkdown's Suspense wrapper, and dropped model-monitor's unused @pollinations/sdk dependency.
gist.impact: Maintainers get less unused code and CSS to carry forward; pollinations.ai has no visual change.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a code garden, pruning three unused button-shaped leaves while leaving the bright, working website flowers untouched; a small markdown plant grows from one shared pot, and an unused SDK package sits in the compost basket.
